en-US.author: BRIGHT ZENITH PRIVATE LIMITED
en-US.description: Agentic Coding Platform for Real Software
en-US.longDescription: Qoder is an agentic coding platform designed for real software development. It seamlessly integrates enhanced context engineering with intelligent agents to gain a comprehensive understanding of your codebase and systematically tackles software development tasks. Supports world's latest and most advanced AI models: Claude, GPT, Gemini, and more. Available for Windows and macOS.
en-US.name: Qoder IDE
en-US.releaseNotes:
Task Duration and Credit Usage Insights, Model Switching for Plan Execution

Features
- View task duration and usage after completion: Check execution time, credit usage, and other details when a task finishes to better understand its execution and cost.
- Switch execution models in Plan mode: Once a plan is generated, choose a different model for execution based on your task needs. Select the right model for each stage to balance quality and cost.
- Manage settings and configuration with qoder-ide-helper: Use /qoder-ide-helper for product guidance, adjust response language, session preferences, and other common settings, and manage rules, commands, and plugins.
- Enterprise administrators can disable Full Access mode: Administrators can disable Full Access mode for all members through the admin console, strengthening organization-wide permission controls.
- New “Keep this device awake” toggle in Settings: Keep your device awake to prevent sleep from interrupting long-running tasks, without adjusting system settings separately.

Improvements
- Tool reasoning and execution details automatically collapse while running, reducing clutter in the conversation and making it easier to stay focused.
- Model switches now provide immediate feedback, so you can confirm whether the change has taken effect.
- Clear quota information and next steps are shown when a promotional model reaches its daily limit.
- The number of files Agent automatically opens at once is now limited by default to reduce stability issues caused by too many tabs. You can adjust or disable the limit as needed.
- Estimated credit usage is shown before the first Wiki generation or a full regeneration for large repositories, helping you assess the cost in advance.
- Improved performance when handling large code changes, many open tabs, and long conversations to reduce UI freezes.
- Optimized WSL terminal profile detection to reduce UI freezes and improve responsiveness.

Fixes
- Fixed repeated sign-ins during startup recovery in the enterprise edition.
- Fixed duplicate server launches and connection recovery failures after WSL extension host restarts.
- Fixed SSH host exits being incorrectly reported as permanent failures.
- Fixed pending clarification questions being incorrectly canceled after an SSH session reconnects following a screen lock.
- Fixed duplicate enterprise Hook registration and repeated SessionStart events.
- Fixed resource leaks in language services, paste and drag-and-drop editing, Notebooks, comments, Timeline, Output, QuickPick, and other modules.
- Fixed file handle exhaustion on macOS to improve connection stability.
- Fixed pagination issues in conversation history to improve conversation loading efficiency.

zh-CN.description: 用于现实软件的自主智能编程平台
zh-CN.longDescription: Qoder 是一个专为现实软件开发而设计的自主智能编程平台。它将增强型上下文工程与智能体无缝结合，全面理解您的代码库，并系统化地完成软件开发任务。支持全球最新、最先进的 AI 模型，包括 Claude、GPT、Gemini 等。适用于 Windows 和 macOS 系统。
